# `noya perps`

_Perpetual-futures execution — orders, positions, deposits, withdrawals._

**12 commands** in this group.

### `noya perps cancel-order`

Cancel an open perp order by its venue order ID

| Flag | Value | Choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--venue` | `<value>` | `hyperliquid` | Perpetual-futures venue. v1 ships Hyperliquid; dYdX / Aevo / etc. land in v2 as their own venue files. (choices: hyperliquid) |
| `--order-id` | `<value>` | — | Venue order ID. On Hyperliquid this is the numeric `oid` as a string. |

### `noya perps capabilities`

The executable-venue + per-op input-schema catalog. Public (no credential needed). Returns each op's input JSON-Schema so a caller can build a valid `op()` call without trial-and-error

_No flags._

### `noya perps create-order`

Place a perp order. perps-engine signs in-process via Privy. Pass `idempotencyKey` to make retries safe — a replay returns the cached result with `idempotentReplay: true` rather than placing a second order

| Flag | Value | Choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--venue` | `<value>` | `hyperliquid` | Perpetual-futures venue. v1 ships Hyperliquid; dYdX / Aevo / etc. land in v2 as their own venue files. (choices: hyperliquid) |
| `--symbol` | `<value>` | — | Venue-native symbol (Hyperliquid `BTC`/`ETH`/`SOL`; uppercase, no `-PERP` suffix). |
| `--side` | `<value>` | `buy`, `sell` | Long = buy, short = sell. (choices: buy, sell) |
| `--size` | `<value>` | — | Order size in base-asset units (e.g. 0.01 = 0.01 ETH). The venue clamps to its per-asset szDecimals. |
| `--price` | `<value>` | — | Limit price (numeric). Required for limit orders. On market orders some venues use this as a slippage cap. |
| `--type` | `<value>` | `limit`, `market` | `limit` = resting order (needs `price`), `market` = taker / IOC. (choices: limit, market) |
| `--tif` | `<value>` | `gtc`, `ioc`, `alo` | Time-in-force for limit orders. `gtc` = good-til-cancel (default), `ioc` = immediate-or-cancel, `alo` = add-liquidity-only. (choices: gtc, ioc, alo) |
| `--reduce-only` | _(boolean)_ | — | If true, the order only reduces (not flips/grows) an existing position; rejected if it would open one. |
| `--leverage` | `<value>` | — | Pre-set leverage; clamped to the venue's per-asset maxLeverage. Apply via `op:update_leverage` for a persistent change. |
| `--margin-mode` | `<value>` | `cross`, `isolated` | Pre-set margin mode. Apply via `op:update_leverage` (isCross) for a persistent change. (choices: cross, isolated) |
| `--trigger-price` | `<value>` | — | Stop / take-profit trigger price. Pair with `tpsl` (`tp` or `sl`) to make a trigger order; omit for a regular limit/market. |
| `--tpsl` | `<value>` | `tp`, `sl` | `tp` = take-profit, `sl` = stop-loss. Requires `triggerPrice`. (choices: tp, sl) |
| `--idempotency-key` | `<value>` | — | Replay guard. A repeated key (15-min TTL, per user+venue) returns the cached result with `idempotentReplay: true` instead of placing a second order. |

### `noya perps credentials-create`

Store a new perp-venue credential for the authenticated user. Requires an OAuth bearer token

| Flag | Value | Choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--venue` | `<value>` | — | Credential-vault venue. **Empty in v1** (Hyperliquid is Privy-derived, stores no row). See `capabilities().credentialVenues`. |
| `--label` | `<value>` | — | Credential label. Defaults to `default` — the one execution uses. |
| `--credentials` | `<value>` | — | The venue's credential object. Shape per `capabilities().credentialSchemas[venue]`. |

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--id` | `<value>` | — | Stored credential ID to soft-delete (revoke). |

| `--label` | `<value>` | — | New label (rename). |
| `--credentials` | `<value>` | — | Replacement credential object (rotate). Same shape as create. |

### `noya perps op`

Run a venue-specific named op (`setup_*`/`approve_*`/`deposit_*`/ `withdraw_*`/`update_*`/`transfer_*` family — e.g. Hyperliquid `setup_agent_wallet`, `approve_agent`, `deposit_usdc`, `withdraw3`, `update_leverage`). Each op's valid `input` shape is discovered at runtime via `capabilities()`

| Flag | Value | Choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--venue` | `<value>` | `hyperliquid` | Perpetual-futures venue. v1 ships Hyperliquid; dYdX / Aevo / etc. land in v2 as their own venue files. (choices: hyperliquid) |
| `--op` | `<value>` | — | Venue-specific named op. Hyperliquid v1: `setup_agent_wallet`, `approve_agent`, `deposit_usdc`, `withdraw3`, `update_leverage`, `update_isolated_margin`, `transfer_usd_class`, `approve_builder_fee`. See `capabilities()`. |
| `--input` | `<value>` | — | Op-specific input object — shape varies per op. See `capabilities().ops[venue][op].inputSchema`. |
